chapters.title: Build every rotation
chapters.code:
def rotate_string(s, goal):
    return len(s) == len(goal) and any(s[i:] + s[:i] == goal for i in range(max(1, len(s))))

chapters.title: Substring of s + s
chapters.code:
def rotate_string(s, goal):
    return len(s) == len(goal) and goal in s + s
